Incident ID: INC-184
Title: Database connection pool exhaustion
Affected Service: aurora-postgres-primary
Severity: P1
Timestamp: 2026-09-24T09:08:00Z
Error Logs: FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections (SQLSTATE 53300). Active pool count: 100/100.
Root Cause: Database connection pool saturated at 50 to 100 connections. Unclosed database cursor handles in transaction retry block caused connection leakage under traffic spikes.
Resolution: Increased database connection pool from 50 to 100 via RDS Parameter Group; patched unclosed connection handle in commit 8f29d1c and deployed connection reaper.
Resolution Succeeded: Yes
Deployment Info: Release v2.13.4
Lead Responder: Sarah Kim (DBA Lead)

Incident ID: INC-178
Title: API 500 errors on ingress gateway
Affected Service: api-gateway-us-east
Severity: P1
Timestamp: 2026-09-21T13:50:00Z
Error Logs: 502 Bad Gateway / upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers. reset reason: connection failure, transport failure reason: delayed_connect_error: 111
Root Cause: Envoy ingress keepalive timeout was set to 60s while upstream microservices had keepalive timeout set to 60s, triggering race condition connection resets.
Resolution: Increased gateway upstream keepalive timeout from 60s to 75s and executed rolling restart of Envoy router pods.
Resolution Succeeded: Yes
Deployment Info: Traefik to Envoy gateway migration v3.1
Lead Responder: Elena Rostova (Infra SRE)

Incident ID: INC-172
Title: Redis memory exhaustion and cache eviction storm
Affected Service: cache-redis-cluster
Severity: P2
Timestamp: 2026-09-17T05:50:00Z
Error Logs: OOM command not allowed when used memory > 'maxmemory' (16GB). Key eviction rate spiked to 14,000 keys/sec; cache hit ratio dropped from 94% to 38%.
Root Cause: Session tokens stored without TTL expiring policy during marketing push filled 16GB RAM limit, causing eviction storm that thrashed backend DB.
Resolution: Applied volatile-lru eviction policy, bumped cluster memory to 32GB, and enforced mandatory 24h TTL on all session keys.
Resolution Succeeded: Yes
Deployment Info: Promotional campaign launch v2.12
Lead Responder: Alex Chen (Lead SRE)

Incident ID: INC-165
Title: Authentication service timeout and JWT validation failure
Affected Service: auth0-session-broker
Severity: P2
Timestamp: 2026-09-12T10:45:00Z
Error Logs: JWKSFetchTimeout: Operation timed out after 5000ms connecting to https://auth.company.com/.well-known/jwks.json. HTTP 504 on /auth/verify.
Root Cause: In-memory JWKS public key cache had a TTL of 60 seconds with no background refresher, causing thundering herd external requests on cache expiration.
Resolution: Increased JWKS cache TTL to 24 hours, added stale-while-revalidate background refresh worker, and cached backup signing keys in Redis.
Resolution Succeeded: Yes
Deployment Info: Auth broker hotfix v1.9.4
Lead Responder: Devin Thorne (Security Core)

Incident ID: INC-159
Title: Payment service timeout on checkout settlement
Affected Service: checkout-payment-svc
Severity: P1
Timestamp: 2026-09-08T18:05:00Z
Error Logs: StripeClient::ApiConnectionError: Request timed out after 30000ms. Celery worker concurrency pool exhausted (32/32 threads active).
Root Cause: Synchronous Stripe webhook confirmation blocked Celery worker threads during upstream provider partial outage; no circuit breaker was configured.
Resolution: Implemented Resilience4j circuit breaker with 5s timeout, switched to asynchronous batch queue processing, and scaled worker replicas from 4 to 12.
Resolution Succeeded: Yes
Deployment Info: Payment gateway v4.0.2
Lead Responder: Elena Rostova (Payments Lead)

Incident ID: INC-152
Title: High API latency and thread pool starvation
Affected Service: customer-profile-api
Severity: P2
Timestamp: 2026-09-02T15:25:00Z
Error Logs: p99 latency degraded from 45ms to 4800ms. Tomcat thread pool active threads: 200/200. HTTP 503 Service Unavailable under load.
Root Cause: Nested synchronous gRPC call to legacy billing service without connection deadline propagation caused all worker threads to block indefinitely.
Resolution: Added 800ms gRPC deadline propagation, enabled non-blocking reactive webclient, and isolated billing lookups behind dedicated thread pool.
Resolution Succeeded: Yes
Deployment Info: Profile v2.8.1
Lead Responder: Marcus Ray (Core Infra)

Incident ID: INC-146
Title: Failed deployment with database migration schema lock
Affected Service: billing-invoice-service
Severity: P1
Timestamp: 2026-08-28T22:00:00Z
Error Logs: ActiveRecord::LockWaitTimeout: Lock wait timeout exceeded; try restarting transaction. ALTER TABLE invoices ADD COLUMN status varchar DEFAULT 'pending'.
Root Cause: Alembic DDL migration attempted to add a non-nullable column with default value on a table with 28M records without concurrent algorithm, locking writes.
Resolution: Aborted and rolled back migration, deployed fix that added column as nullable first, backfilled asynchronously, and applied NOT NULL constraint without locking.
Resolution Succeeded: Yes
Deployment Info: Helm release release-billing-v2.14.0
Lead Responder: Sarah Kim (Database Lead)

Incident ID: INC-139
Title: PostgreSQL connection failure on read replicas
Affected Service: aurora-postgres-primary
Severity: P1
Timestamp: 2026-08-20T07:45:00Z
Error Logs: psycopg2.OperationalError: could not connect to server: Connection refused. Is the server running on host aurora-ro-replica-1.cluster.internal and accepting TCP/IP connections?
Root Cause: Engine upgrade on AWS RDS Aurora read replica crashed due to corrupted temporary tablespace disk volume, failing DNS failover switch.
Resolution: Re-pointed database reader endpoint to replica-2, purged corrupted tablespace volume, and enabled AWS RDS Multi-AZ automated failover proxy.
Resolution Succeeded: Yes
Deployment Info: Aurora PostgreSQL 15.4 minor engine patch
Lead Responder: Marcus Ray (Database Lead)

Incident ID: INC-131
Title: Memory leak in Node.js event listener on SSE stream
Affected Service: notification-stream-svc
Severity: P2
Timestamp: 2026-08-14T01:30:00Z
Error Logs: FATAL ERROR: Ineffective mark-compacts near heap limit Allocation failed - JavaScript heap out of memory. Node.js process restarted every 45 minutes.
Root Cause: Long-lived Server-Sent Events (SSE) connections did not remove socket 'data' and 'close' event listeners on client disconnect, leaking 1.8MB per closed socket.
Resolution: Fixed event listener cleanup on 'close' signal, wrapped emitter in WeakMap reference, and adjusted V8 max_old_space_size from 2048 to 4096MB.
Resolution Succeeded: Yes
Deployment Info: Real-time notification engine v1.4
Lead Responder: Alex Chen (Lead SRE)

Incident ID: INC-125
Title: Service crash due to unhandled SIGTERM in worker container
Affected Service: async-worker-pool
Severity: P1
Timestamp: 2026-08-08T11:40:00Z
Error Logs: Kubernetes PodEviction: OOMKilled and ungraceful exit code 137. In-flight Kafka message batch dropped without offset commit acknowledgment.
Root Cause: Worker process ignored Kubernetes preStop lifecycle hook and SIGTERM signal, instantly terminating container while holding in-flight uncommitted Kafka transactions.
Resolution: Implemented graceful shutdown signal handler with 30s grace period to flush Kafka consumer offsets before exit; updated Kubernetes terminationGracePeriodSeconds to 60s.
Resolution Succeeded: Yes
Deployment Info: Kubernetes manifest update cluster-prod
Lead Responder: Elena Rostova (DevOps Core)

Incident ID: INC-TEST-99

Root Cause: Heartbeat interval exceeded max.poll.interval.ms under large message batches
Resolution: Increased max.poll.interval.ms from 300s to 600s and reduced max.poll.records to 250

Incident ID: INC-165
Title: Authentication service timeout and JWT validation failure
Affected Service: auth-service
Severity: P1
Timestamp: 2026-09-14T11:15:00Z
Error Logs: JWKSRetrievalTimeout: Failed to fetch public key set from Auth0 endpoint within 500ms timeout threshold. Signature verification aborted.
Root Cause: Stale JWKS public key cache eviction forced synchronous remote HTTP call on every request; outbound NAT gateway connection pool saturated.
Resolution: Increased local JWKS memory cache TTL from 5m to 24h with stale-while-revalidate background refresh worker.
Resolution Succeeded: Yes
Deployment Info: Security patch release v1.8.9

Incident ID: INC-158
Title: Payment gateway timeout and cascade circuit breaker trip
Affected Service: payment-service
Severity: P1
Timestamp: 2026-09-10T17:40:00Z
Error Logs: CircuitBreakerOpenException: payment_gateway_stripe circuit breaker tripped. 54% failure rate in 60s sliding window.
Root Cause: Third-party payment gateway latency spiked to 8,000ms. In-memory worker thread pool exhausted waiting for HTTP responses without socket timeout.
Resolution: Configured strict 3,000ms HTTP socket timeout, increased Resilience4j circuit breaker open threshold to 70%, and enabled Redis dead-letter fallback queue.
Resolution Succeeded: Yes
Deployment Info: Payment microservice v4.2.0
Lead Responder: Marcus Vance (Payments Lead)

Incident ID: INC-152
Title: High API latency and thread pool starvation
Affected Service: order-service
Severity: P2
Timestamp: 2026-09-06T14:35:00Z
Error Logs: ThreadPoolExecutor: pool size 200 reached, active threads 200, queued tasks 1850. p99 response time jumped from 45ms to 3,800ms.
Root Cause: Nested synchronous gRPC call to legacy billing service without connection deadline propagation caused all worker threads to block indefinitely.
Resolution: Added 800ms gRPC deadline propagation, enabled non-blocking reactive webclient, and isolated billing lookups behind dedicated thread pool.
Resolution Succeeded: Yes
Deployment Info: Order routing update v3.5.2
Lead Responder: Priya Patel (Core Platform)

Incident ID: INC-144
Title: Failed deployment database migration table lock
Affected Service: user-service
Severity: P1
Timestamp: 2026-09-02T03:10:00Z
Error Logs: ERROR: canceling statement due to lock timeout. Process 4129 waits for ExclusiveLock on relation 'users_profile_tbl'. All write queries queued.
Root Cause: Flyway migration script added NOT NULL column with default expression without lock timeout guard, blocking production read-write transactions.
Resolution: Aborted migration transaction, set lock_timeout = '2s', added column as NULLABLE in step 1, backfilled in batches, and added constraint as VALIDATE ONLY.
Resolution Succeeded: Yes
Deployment Info: User Schema Migration Release v2.9.0
Lead Responder: Sarah Kim (DBA Lead)

Incident ID: INC-137
Title: PostgreSQL replica replication lag and WAL backlog
Affected Service: data-warehouse
Severity: P2
Timestamp: 2026-08-28T21:40:00Z
Error Logs: Postgres WAL sender process killed: replication delay exceeded 14GB / 3600 seconds. Read replica lag spiked to 42 minutes.
Root Cause: Long-running analytical export query on read replica acquired catalog locks that conflicted with applied WAL streaming changes.
Resolution: Enabled max_standby_streaming_delay = 30s, enabled hot_standby_feedback = on, and isolated heavy analytical queries to dedicated ETL replica.
Resolution Succeeded: Yes
Deployment Info: Nightly batch analytical exporter v1.2
Lead Responder: Alex Chen (Lead SRE)

Incident ID: INC-129
Title: Notification service SSE connection memory leak
Affected Service: notification-service
Severity: P2
Timestamp: 2026-08-24T15:20:00Z
Error Logs: FATAL ERROR: Ineffective mark-compacts near heap limit Allocation failed - JavaScript heap out of memory. RSS memory grew from 250MB to 1.8GB.
Root Cause: Server-Sent Events connection cleanup handler failed to unbind client event listeners on unexpected TCP close, leaking connection buffers in memory.
Resolution: Rewrote SSE disconnect lifecycle handler with explicit listener removal, added heartbeat ping-pong, and capped max heap to 2GB with container auto-recycle.
Resolution Succeeded: Yes
Deployment Info: Realtime notification update v2.4.1
Lead Responder: Elena Rostova (Infra SRE)

Incident ID: INC-121
Title: Async worker crash loop from unhandled SIGTERM signal
Affected Service: async-worker
Severity: P2
Timestamp: 2026-08-20T08:00:00Z
Error Logs: K8s Pod OOMKilled/CrashLoopBackOff: exit code 137. 24 unacknowledged messages re-queued onto RabbitMQ dead-letter exchange concurrently.
Root Cause: Kubernetes node preemption sent SIGTERM to Celery workers; shutdown handler did not wait for in-flight jobs to complete before terminating database session.
Resolution: Configured terminationGracePeriodSeconds to 60s in Pod spec and added graceful SIGTERM drain handler with Celery warm shutdown.
Resolution Succeeded: Yes
Deployment Info: Node autoscaler upgrade v1.28
Lead Responder: Alex Chen (Lead SRE)

Incident ID: INC-115
Title: PostgreSQL deadlock during batch invoice generation
Affected Service: billing-db
Severity: P1
Timestamp: 2026-08-16T09:45:00Z
Error Logs: ERROR: deadlock detected. Process 14892 waits for ShareLock on transaction 8921827; Process 14893 waits for ExclusiveLock on tuple (48, 12).
Root Cause: Concurrent billing cron jobs acquired row locks on customer invoices in reverse primary key order, triggering deterministic database deadlocks.
Resolution: Sorted customer invoice IDs prior to acquiring SELECT FOR UPDATE row locks, eliminating lock inversion order.
Resolution Succeeded: Yes
Deployment Info: Monthly subscription billing cycle v2.10
Lead Responder: Sarah Kim (DBA Lead)

Incident ID: INC-110
Title: High CPU throttling on Checkout microservice
Affected Service: checkout-service
Severity: P2
Timestamp: 2026-08-12T13:05:00Z
Error Logs: cgroup CPU throttling exceeded 84% on checkout-worker pods. p99 response time spiked from 25ms to 2,400ms.
Root Cause: Regex catastrophic backtracking in promo code validation routine caused exponential CPU evaluation on strings with repeated hyphens.
Resolution: Rewrote promo code regex validator using linear RE2 engine without backtracking and increased Kubernetes CPU limits from 1.0 to 2.5 cores.
Resolution Succeeded: Yes
Deployment Info: Summer promotion release v3.4.1
Lead Responder: Priya Patel (Core Platform)

Incident ID: INC-105
Title: Kafka consumer group rebalance storm
Affected Service: event-streaming-kafka
Severity: P1
Timestamp: 2026-08-08T18:50:00Z
Error Logs: CommitFailedException: Offset commit cannot be completed since the group has already rebalanced. max.poll.interval.ms exceeded.
Root Cause: Heavy image processing task inside Kafka message handler exceeded 300,000ms poll interval, causing coordinator to evict consumer and trigger perpetual rebalance.
Resolution: Decoupled image processing onto asynchronous worker thread pool and increased max.poll.interval.ms from 5m to 15m.
Resolution Succeeded: Yes
Deployment Info: Media pipeline upgrade v1.9.0
Lead Responder: Elena Rostova (Infra SRE)

Incident ID: INC-098
Title: Elasticsearch cluster yellow status and JVM memory pressure
Affected Service: search-cluster
Severity: P2
Timestamp: 2026-08-04T11:25:00Z
Error Logs: CircuitBreakingException: [parent] Data too large, data for [<transport_request>] would be [31849182740/29.6gb], which is larger than the limit of [30601641984/28.5gb].
Root Cause: Unbounded wildcard terms aggregation over catalog search logs filled JVM fielddata cache, tripping the circuit breaker and stalling index queries.
Resolution: Cleared fielddata cache, disabled wildcard aggregations on non-keyword fields, and added indices.fielddata.cache.size: 20% limit.
Resolution Succeeded: Yes
Deployment Info: Search telemetry expansion v2.6
Lead Responder: Marcus Vance (Search Team)

Incident ID: INC-092
Title: Core DNS resolution timeout on AWS NAT Gateway
Affected Service: core-network
Severity: P1
Timestamp: 2026-07-31T06:45:00Z
Error Logs: dial tcp: lookup api.stripe.com on 10.0.0.2:53: i/o timeout. 5-second DNS resolution latency spikes on outbound HTTPS calls.
Root Cause: Node-local CoreDNS daemonset crashed on 3 worker nodes due to conntrack table exhaustion on Linux kernel netfilter.
Resolution: Increased nf_conntrack_max from 262144 to 1048576 via sysctl and deployed NodeLocal DNSCache daemon to bypass conntrack for internal lookups.
Resolution Succeeded: Yes
Deployment Info: Kubernetes 1.28 cluster patch
Lead Responder: Elena Rostova (Infra SRE)

Incident ID: INC-087
Title: S3 multipart upload file descriptor leak
Affected Service: asset-storage-svc
Severity: P2
Timestamp: 2026-07-27T16:55:00Z
Error Logs: EMFILE: too many open files. Process exceeded ulimit of 1024 open file descriptors. New incoming upload requests refused with 500.
Root Cause: Temporary upload staging chunks were opened with fs.createReadStream without listening to error event, leaving file descriptors open on client abort.
Resolution: Used stream.pipeline() with auto-close semantics, raised container nofile ulimit to 65535, and scheduled automated orphaned chunk cleanup cron.
Resolution Succeeded: Yes
Deployment Info: Asset upload service v1.6.3
Lead Responder: Devin Torres (SecOps Lead)

Incident ID: INC-081
Title: Ingress edge SSL intermediate certificate expiration
Affected Service: k8s-ingress-edge
Severity: P1
Timestamp: 2026-07-23T03:50:00Z
Error Logs: SEC_ERROR_UNKNOWN_ISSUER / Peer's Certificate issuer is not recognized. Edge SSL handshake dropped for 100% of non-cached mobile clients.
Root Cause: cert-manager secret renewed leaf certificate but omitted full intermediate CA chain bundle in TLS Kubernetes secret.
Resolution: Re-issued certificate using cert-manager with fullchain.pem including Sectigo intermediate bundle, and restarted edge Traefik pods.
Resolution Succeeded: Yes
Deployment Info: Automated certificate rotation cycle
Lead Responder: Alex Chen (Lead SRE)

Incident ID: INC-076
Title: Rate limiting token bucket Redis desync
Affected Service: rate-limiter-service
Severity: P2
Timestamp: 2026-07-19T21:10:00Z
Error Logs: HTTP 429 Too Many Requests returned for valid internal API consumers. Token bucket counter evaluated negative balance.
Root Cause: Non-atomic GET then SET operations in rate limiter allowed concurrent worker race condition to overwrite bucket timestamp with future clock drift.
Resolution: Migrated rate-limiting logic to atomic Redis Lua script executing token replenishment and deduction in a single transaction.
Resolution Succeeded: Yes
Deployment Info: API security hardening v2.3.0
Lead Responder: Priya Patel (Core Platform)

Incident ID: INC-071
Title: Node.js WebSocket gateway memory leak during reconnect storms
Affected Service: realtime-gateway
Severity: P1
Timestamp: 2026-07-15T14:15:00Z
Error Logs: FATAL ERROR: CALL_AND_RETRY_LAST Allocation failed - JavaScript heap out of memory. 14 gateway pods restarted simultaneously.
Root Cause: Client reconnect storm queued offline messages in an unbounded array per socket without backpressure limits.
Resolution: Implemented bounded circular ring buffer (max 100 queued messages per client) and applied exponential reconnect jitter on frontend SDK.
Resolution Succeeded: Yes
Deployment Info: Realtime chat release v3.0.1
Lead Responder: Elena Rostova (Infra SRE)

Incident ID: INC-065
Title: Failed canary deployment route saturation
Affected Service: inventory-service
Severity: P2
Timestamp: 2026-07-11T10:00:00Z
Error Logs: Argo Rollouts canary weight 10% overwhelmed single canary replica pod. CPU 100%, 503 Service Unavailable for 12% of traffic.
Root Cause: Canary step configuration increased traffic weight before horizontal pod autoscaler (HPA) had scaled minimum replicas from 1 to 4.
Resolution: Added minimum replica constraint (minReplicas: 4) before canary traffic shift and configured automated rollback on 5xx error rate > 2%.
Resolution Succeeded: Yes
Deployment Info: Canary Rollout v2.1.0
Lead Responder: Alex Chen (Lead SRE)

Incident ID: INC-058
Title: Unindexed foreign key constraint query spillover
Affected Service: reporting-db
Severity: P2
Timestamp: 2026-07-07T15:45:00Z
Error Logs: Seq Scan on order_items (cost=0.00..1849182.20 rows=48210920). Query execution time: 142 seconds, saturating IOPS limit on EBS gp3 volume.
Root Cause: Deletion cascade on parent orders table triggered full sequential table scan on 48M row child table lacking index on order_id column.
